# Radio

A single option inside a `RadioGroup`, built on react-aria-components `Radio`. The circular control is drawn entirely in CSS (no icon assets) and reflects selection, hover, focus, invalid, and disabled states via RAC data attributes (`data-selected`, `data-hovered`, `data-focus-visible`, `data-invalid`, `data-disabled`).

Import: `import { Radio } from '@ds/react';` — the only public entry point.

Built on react-aria-components `Radio`; keyboard behavior, ARIA, and focus management ship inside. All `Radio` base props (e.g. event handlers, `isDisabled`, `autoFocus`) are also legal here, with the props listed below overriding or narrowing them.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | yes | — | Label content rendered next to the CSS-drawn control. Required: every radio needs a visible accessible name. |
| `className` | `string` | no | — | Additional CSS class appended after the component's own classes. Narrowed from the react-aria-components render-prop form to a plain string; inline `style` is intentionally not supported (token rule). |
| `value` | `string` | yes | — | Value this option contributes to the group: it is compared against the group's `value`/`defaultValue` and passed to the group's `onChange` when the option is selected. |

## Accessibility

- Keyboard behavior, ARIA semantics, and focus management come from react-aria-components `Radio` — never re-implement or bypass them.
- Interaction states are exposed as data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`, …); the focus-visible ring uses `var(--ds-color-border-focus)` and `var(--ds-shadow-focus-ring)`.
- Color pairs used by this system are contrast-audited (WCAG 2.2 AA (normal text)); see registries/contrast-report.json. Only audited foreground/background token pairs are legal.

## Examples

```tsx
<Radio value="email">Email</Radio>
<Radio value="sms" isDisabled>SMS</Radio>
```
